propositions: Convergence tests that re-derive the external-effect side using the same helpers under test instead of capturing from the real call site remain green when the call site drifts, defeating their purpose.

The rule distinguishing sanctioned characterization tests from defective re-derived oracles is intent-based (whether a side represents an external effect) rather than syntactically detectable, making a lint check infeasible without unacceptable false positives.

Test-design guidance must be recorded in the shared standard (`examples/agent-skills/shared/test-design.md` §4) and synced byte-identically to all consuming skill copies, enforced by the existing gating test.

Two historical instances demonstrate the defect: stale `truncate_comment_body` model in convergence test, and re-derived `fit_preserving_marker(...)` composition that passed Gerrit CI while breaking live Jira.
